tokens.name: chi-red
tokens.usage: The CHI wordmark red, measured from the master logo artwork. RGB 217 / 33 / 45. Fixed in every theme. Print: match to the approved press proof; nearest coated spot reference is Pantone 1795 C, to be confirmed against a swatch book before first print run.

tokens.name: chi-black
tokens.usage: The black of the sub-brand descriptor in the logo artwork. RGB 16 / 15 / 13. Fixed in every theme. Print: 100K for small type, rich black for large solids.

tokens.name: chi-white
tokens.usage: Pure white. The default ground for the logo and for packaging and page layouts. Fixed in every theme.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Fill for the one primary action on a screen, key headlines blocks and campaign panels. Carries `on-brand` text. Never use it as a text colour on dark grounds; use `brand-text`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` and `brand-strong` fills (4.99:1 and 7.0:1).

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `brand` fills. Carries `on-brand` text.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Red used as text or as a link: on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `brand-tint`. At least 4.99:1 on each in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet red wash behind promotional notes and selected rows. Carries `ink` or `brand-text`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and packaging ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Ceramic grey. Cards, product tiles, alternate page bands.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Image placeholders, input wells, table headers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `brand-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, legal lines and secondary copy on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (5.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers that carry no meaning on their own.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls on `surface` and `surface-raised` (3.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every surface. On `brand` fills the ring sits outside the fill on the ground.

tokens.name: silk
tokens.usage: Warm champagne for treatment, oil and care stories. A panel colour only, never text. Carries `on-silk`.

tokens.name: on-silk
tokens.usage: Text on `silk` panels (14.6:1).

tokens.name: heat-low
tokens.usage: Lowest band of the heat scale on styling tools and heat-protection content. Always paired with a temperature label. Carries `on-heat`.

tokens.name: heat-mid
tokens.usage: Middle band of the heat scale. Always paired with a temperature label. Carries `on-heat`.

tokens.name: heat-high
tokens.usage: Top band of the heat scale. Always paired with a temperature label. Carries `on-brand`.

tokens.name: on-heat
tokens.usage: Text on `heat-low` and `heat-mid` (10.4:1 and 6.8:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and icons on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Shares the brand red, so every error also carries an icon and the word that says what went wrong.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Campaign headlines, posters, hero panels. Four words or fewer.

styles.name: descriptor-l
styles.usage: Line and range names set in capitals beside a headline. Echoes the light capitals under the wordmark.

styles.name: descriptor-s
styles.usage: Eyebrows, claim badges, category labels. Capitals only.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Ceramic heat and silk care, made for the chair and for the bathroom mirror.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mist evenly over damp hair, comb through, then style as usual.
styles.usage: Running copy. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, button labels.

styles.name: legal
styles.sample: CHI® is a registered trademark of Farouk Systems, Inc.
styles.usage: Trademark lines, ingredient lists, regulatory copy. Never smaller than 6pt in print.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges; between a title and its caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; horizontal padding of buttons; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline and the block it introduces.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on desktop; poster margins.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero padding; clear band around campaign panels.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default. Buttons, cards, panels, badges and images are square, like the H and I of the wordmark.

tokens.name: radius-soft
tokens.usage: Inputs and small thumbnails only, where a hard corner looks broken at small sizes.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Colour dots in shade pickers and avatar crops. Never buttons.
